name: email-templates
description: The look of outgoing mail: per-mailbox HTML templates with a footer, seasonal picks (Christmas, Summer...), agent-drafted designs, and one-click activation. Sending applies the active template automatically.
env_example: # Footer line under every outgoing message (leave the built-in, or brand it).
# EMAIL_TEMPLATE_DISABLE=1    # send bare HTML, no wrapper at all
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 012_email_templates.sql, hot-loads the app).
Every mailbox already sends with a built-in default — nothing to set up. Browse /api/email-templates/ to add templates and activate them per mailbox.
Seasonal use: create a 'Christmas' template and activate it on a mailbox; switch back (deactivate) when the season ends.
The single send path applies the active template automatically — replies, digests and any other sender get it for free. Cross-language callers use the email.render capability.
